title: FHFA House Price Index — Quarterly Index with Monthly Tables (June 2027 and 2027Q2), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: fhfa.gov/data/hpi, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) and parsed in full rather than inherited from the fhfa-hpi chain's own siblings. Its posted "2027 HPI Release Dates" table reads, verbatim and in order, "Tuesday, January 26 | Monthly Index | November 2026", "Tuesday, February 23 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | December 2026 and 2026Q4", "Tuesday, March 30", "Tuesday, April 27", "Tuesday, May 25 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | March 2027 and 2027Q1", "Tuesday, June 29", "Tuesday, July 27", "TUESDAY, AUGUST 31 | QUARTERLY INDEX (WITH MONTHLY TABLES) | JUNE 2027 AND 2027Q2", "Tuesday, September 28", "Tuesday, October 26", "Tuesday, November 30 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | September 2027 and 2027Q3", "Tuesday, December 28" -- twelve rows, every one a last Tuesday, with the quarterly editions on Feb 23 / May 25 / Aug 31 / Nov 30. The 9:00 a.m. ET release time is this repo's existing fhfa-hpi convention, carried from the fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 entry's own primary (the published 2026Q2 report's release-dates appendix, which states "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET"); it was NOT separately re-sourced this session, and the landing page parsed here carries no time. Filed estimate, not confirmed, for two reasons and neither is a weak source: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and a posted forward calendar 12 months out is a schedule rather than a commitment -- FHFA restates the table each year. notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-08-31 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06) and proposed for a reason that outlives the event itself. FHFA and the Conference Board publish on THE SAME last-Tuesday cadence, so an FHFA HPI release and a Consumer Confidence print land on the same morning every month -- an adjacency this calendar already reflects in the other direction (proposals/consumer-confidence-2027-01-26.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26.json and two siblings were filed BY the fhfa-hpi lane). What is new here is that FHFA POSTS ITS CALENDAR A YEAR AHEAD and the Conference Board does not, which makes the FHFA table an independent, primary check on the arithmetic behind every estimate the consumer-confidence chain files: all twelve 2027 rows match this chain's rule-derived last Tuesdays, 12 of 12. THIS PARTICULAR DATE IS THE DENSER OF THE TWO CLASSES. 2027-08-31 carries the QUARTERLY HPI edition (June 2027 and 2027Q2), not a monthly one, and it releases at 9:00 ET -- one hour AHEAD of the 10:00 Consumer Confidence print, on a session that is simultaneously the last Tuesday, the last calendar day and the last trading session of August. The consumer-confidence lane's own measurement is that none of that is worth anything at daily-bar resolution (its print is 0 of 9 against every control, and month-final sessions are 0 of 9 against the rest), but the stacking is real at intraday resolution, which no ledger in this calendar has yet studied. Only THIS date is proposed: the other eleven 2027 rows are the fhfa-hpi lane's own chain to extend and sit outside this event's corridor. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
